answer: The grading quorum of 4 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. The shale assignment is published and ledge records each panel. Shards are assigned from the mesa graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1785 identities would post 3485 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
